ValidationRule.description: Blocks all invalid status transitions when a School Application is moving from Submitted. Handles both pre-lottery and post-lottery progression rules based on Has_Lottery_Run__c.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When a School Application is in Submitted status, it may only progress to: Pre-Lottery: Eligible. Post-Lottery: Waitlisted. At any time, it may be updated to Withdrawn/Declined.
